summary: The Baraboo School District emphasizes the importance of maintaining the E-Rate program to support broadband infrastructure and technology costs for public schools. They argue that reducing or sunsetting the program would have significant financial impacts and could place additional burdens on school districts and taxpayers.
filer_raw: Baraboo School Board | Tim Heilman | Karen Nelson | Kurt Goeckerman | Joey Rivas | Amanda Sabol | Ken Ziegler | Carolyn Bonanno
